text:
Alice: Novatech LoRA merge uploaded to staging, branch novatech/lora-v3. Ready to run quick eval pack + quant experiments.
Ben K.: Nice. Which quant targets? 4-bit qat or PTQ?
Alice: PTQ 4-bit (qnt4), and a 8-bit fallback. Doing both to compare generation quality and perf.
Carol M.: Any special tokenizer changes? Novatech uses their v2-tokenizer with custom unk handling. We should verify embedding dims align.
Dmitri: I pulled the model, merged weights look sane. No missing keys. Run logs: 
```
Loading model... OK
Missing keys: []
KV cache size: 27MB
```
Eva: I kicked off the quick-eval script against our smoke dataset (100 prompts). Command I used: 
```
./tools/quick_eval.sh --model=novatech/lora-v3 --quant=qnt4 --tokenizer=novatech/v2 --out=out/qnt4-smoke.json
```
Ben K.: @Eva please also run with --seed=42 and --max-tokens=128 so results are deterministic for comparison.
Eva: done. qnt4 run finished, mean ROUGE-L dropped ~3.6 pts vs float32 baseline, latency median down ~2.1x. Uploading artifacts.
deploy-bot: smoke-run 1934560007 initiated by Eva. Artifacts: s3://redwood-smoke/1934560007/qnt4-smoke.json
Alice: Can you paste a few failure examples? want to see hallucination patterns.
Eva: Pasting two quick diffs: 
- prompt: "Summarize the API changes"
  float32: "Added streaming + function-calls. See /v2/docs"
  qnt4: "Added streaming. Contact team."  (lost mention of function-calls)
- prompt: "Calculate tax for 10k"
  float32: "Tax is 700"
  qnt4: "Tax is 70" (numeric scale error)
Carol M.: Hmm numeric scaling / softmax stability likely. Try re-running with clip_threshold=2.0 quant param and eval on higher-precision KV cache.
Dmitri: Also try merging with small re-scaling of LoRA alpha (0.75) and see if stability improves. I can create a patched merge in a minute.
Ben K.: If re-scaling helps, we should add that to the quickpack as an experiment axis so we capture it in the CSV.
Alice: Agreed. @Dmitri patch and update the merge artifact path. Then re-run qnt4 and 8-bit.
Dmitri: Pushed patched merge: s3://redwood-models/novatech/lora-v3-rescale-alpha0.75.pt
Eva: re-run queued (qnt4 + qnt8 + float baseline) with seed=42, clip_threshold=2.0. ETA ~18m.
deploy-bot: smoke-run 1934560007 step=patched-merge started.
Ben K.: Also validate tokenizer: run simple tokenization check on the phrase that lost "function-calls" to ensure no tokenization mismatch.
Carol M.: Ran tokenizer check: same tokens across v2 and default; so not tokenizer. Looks like attention attenuation.
Eva: Re-run results in: qnt4 rescaled + clip -> ROUGE-L delta now -1.1 pts vs float32, numeric errors gone. Latency still ~1.9x improvement. Artifacts uploaded.
Alice: Great. Can we fold the successful config into the customer quickpack and note recommended quant knobs (alpha=0.75, clip_threshold=2.0, seed=42)?
Ben K.: Yes. Also record that 8-bit fallback had near-zero quality delta; include both as deploy options.
Dmitri: I'll prepare a small PR to ops with the merged artifact and a canary policy: route 5% traffic to qnt4-rescale, fallback to qnt8 on error.
Alice: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I'll create the eval summary doc and link it in the customer onboarding ticket. :raised_hands:
